body.title: Returns policy
body.text:
Northstar Goods return policy (synthetic).
Change-of-mind returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery.
Original packaging and proof of purchase are required.

body.title: Account help
body.text: To reset your Northstar Goods password, open the sign-in page, choose Forgot password, and follow the emailed reset link. Never share your password or reset link.
